decisions.reason: The air quality sensor got its own product page, fits the announced expansion of the sensing platform, and the development already invested in it argues for persistence.
The voltage module is only mentioned on the website, so the firm's public commitment is lower, but it is a core measurement building block and cheap to keep in a modular catalog.
The MQTT proxy has its own page and directly serves the firm's stated push toward richer software bindings and connectivity, so management will stand by it.
The CAN bus module has had little visible promotion, but it extends the connectivity direction the firm has announced, and its hardware investment has already been made.
The CO2 sensor got its own page and fits the firm's growing environmental sensing line, so it is likely to be kept even if early sales are modest.
The touch panel accessory was visibly launched on its own page and complements the kit ecosystem, so management will attribute any weak uptake to market ramp-up.
